layout: plane p (stacked north-to-south), channel c = azimuth 4 (p mod 4) + c; planes 0-3 the far band, 4-7 the near band
footprints: cells under a roof carry the nearest open cell's angles
observer: DGM1 ground; occluders DGM1 + LoD2 surfaces (no trees); the sky view's crowns let half the sky through
beyond: Copernicus GLO-30, smoothed, -3.62 m onto the DGM1; the far band past 1500 m from it alone, to 10000 m
